text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Osaka Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит and Нарита Таисин are
both
racing? This is gonna be great!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I saw BNW at the Kikuka Sho, and
it's
always amazing when they face off!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
In the stands for today's race, fans are

anticipating an exciting showdown
between
Уиннинг Тикит and Narita
Taishin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So many fans called out to me on the
way here, it
was crazy.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
That means they have high hopes, right?
I'll do
my best and give them a race to
remember!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I hope I can meet their expectations. I'm so nervous, it's making me feel all itchy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
You've just got to go out there and achieve
something great!

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Okay, gotta do my best!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I did what I could в тренировке. All
that's left is
to get in the spirit...
WOOHOO!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: All right, here I go! See you, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
